mapper.select:
SELECT c.channel_num, c.team_num, c.channel_name, c.category, c.channel_desc, c.is_default,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message m WHERE m.channel_num = c.channel_num AND m.message_num > NVL(rs.last_read_message_num, 0) ) AS unreadCount,
(SELECT NVL(msg.content, '📁 ' || f.origin_name) FROM chat_message msg LEFT JOIN chat_file f ON msg.message_num = f.message_num WHERE msg.message_num = ( SELECT MAX(message_num) FROM chat_message WHERE channel_num = c.channel_num ) ) AS lastMessage,
(SELECT TO_CHAR(send_date, 'AM HH:MI') FROM chat_message WHERE message_num = ( SELECT MAX(message_num) FROM chat_message WHERE channel_num = c.channel_num ) ) AS lastTime FROM chat_channel c LEFT OUTER JOIN chat_read_status rs ON c.channel_num = rs.channel_num AND rs.user_num = #{user_num} WHERE c.team_num = #{team_num} ORDER BY c.channel_num ASC

select m.message_num, m.channel_num, m.user_num, m.content, m.parent_message, m.send_date, u.user_name as userName, f.file_num, f.origin_name, f.file_type, f.file_size, pm.content as parentContent, pu.user_name as parentUserName from chat_message m join users u on m.user_num = u.user_num left outer join chat_file f on m.message_num = f.message_num left outer join chat_message pm on m.parent_message = pm.message_num left join users pu on pm.user_num = pu.user_num where m.channel_num = #{channel_num} order by m.message_num asc
mapper.insert:
select seq_chat_channel.nextval from dual
insert into chat_channel( channel_num, team_num, channel_name, is_default, create_date, create_by, channel_desc, category )values ( #{channel_num}, #{team_num}, #{channel_name}, NVL(#{is_default,jdbcType=CHAR},'N'), sysdate, #{create_by}, #{channel_desc}, #{category} )

select seq_chat_message.nextval from dual
insert into chat_message( message_num, channel_num, user_num, content, send_date, parent_message )values ( #{message_num}, #{channel_num}, #{user_num}, #{content}, sysdate, #{parent_message,jdbcType=NUMERIC} )

select seq_chat_file.nextval from dual
insert into chat_file( file_num, message_num, channel_num, uploader_num, origin_name, save_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, upload_date, team_num, folder_num, file_source ) values ( #{file_num}, #{message_num}, #{channel_num}, #{uploader_num}, #{origin_name}, #{save_name}, #{file_path}, #{file_size}, #{file_type}, SYSDATE, #{team_num}, #{folder_num,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{file_source} )
